title: Retirement by disuse must not touch what a review holds
body: Keep the exclusions of retireByDisuse (src/maintenance/retire.js) in the selector itself, so health never names a memory the sweep would decline to touch: a contested memory, a memory a pending candidate names in `replaces`, and a memory a person accepted or edited (review.accepted.by "person") stay out of it, whatever retire.after_sessions says. Why: a revision whose target was retired can never be accepted, and the candidate looks normal until someone presses Accept; a reviewer's held memories must not move under them. v1 shipped the race in 2026-09 and v2 re-learned it in the retire tests on 2026-10-13.
not_derivable: The code exempts them; that a retired revision target strands its candidate, and that v1 shipped the race, is written nowhere in it.

evidence.summary: retireByDisuse retires only active memories not accepted by a person and not named by a pending candidate's replaces.
A memory a pending candidate revises is not retired.
